column1: # Diacritic fold table for the R2 snapshot search index (phase 0 spike).
# One `<char>\t<folded>` pair per line, lowercase source characters only.
# Hand-written Latin entries first, then every other lowercase letter whose
# Unicode 15.0 NFKD form carries a combining mark, folded to its base
# letters (Greek tonos, kana dakuten, Cyrillic breve, ...): scene posts
# strip those marks in every script, not only Latin.

# index builder (examples/snapshot_build.rs) and the query side call, so
